name: aiand-copilot-chat
description: Use hosted ai& (Aiand) models in GitHub Copilot Chat with your Aiand API key.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestions.description: Experimental. Provide ghost-text inline completions while typing, powered by the Aiand gateway with reasoning_effort none. Credentials, prompts, and document context are never logged.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsModel.description: Model id used for inline completions. Defaults to the low-latency flash tier.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsChatInput.description: Also offer inline completions inside the Copilot Chat prompt box.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsDebounceMs.description: Debounce window in milliseconds between typing and an inline completion request.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsTimeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for inline completions.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsPrefixLine.description: Lines of document context sent before the cursor.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsSuffixChar.description: Characters of document context sent after the cursor.

enumDescriptions: Use less reasoning for lower latency and cost.
Balance reasoning depth, latency, and cost.
Use deeper reasoning for complex tasks.
aiandCopilot.reasoningEffort.description: Default Aiand reasoning effort. A Copilot model-picker selection overrides this value.

aiandCopilot.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens requested from Aiand hosted models. Use 0 to reserve up to 32,768 response tokens. Positive values are capped by the model output capability and context window.

aiandCopilot.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration of a Aiand inference request in seconds.

aiandCopilot.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time without receiving streamed Aiand response data before aborting a request.

aiandCopilot.catalogCacheMinutes.description: How long the Aiand hosted-model catalog is reused before refreshing.

aiandCopilot.showUsageStatusBar.description: Show the active Aiand account credit balance and request allowance in the status bar.

aiandCopilot.debugLogging.description: Log request, stream, usage, and model-discovery metadata to the Aiand output channel. Prompts and API keys are never logged.

apiKey.title: Aiand API Key
apiKey.description: API key for this Aiand provider entry. VS Code stores configured secrets securely.
